scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for Assistance to Mega Industries: Assistance of Interest Subsidy
other_conditions: The unit must operate as a manufacturing unit
Minimum investment of INR 2,500 crore in plant and machinery
Must provide direct employment to at least 2,500 persons
Must belong to one of the thrust sectors defined in the Guidelines
Eligible for new industrial units or expansion projects
Must avail term loans for fixed capital investment from recognized financial institutions
Unit must bear at least 2% interest on term loans, even if availing other subsidies
Must ensure regular repayment of loan installments
benefits_summary: Provides an interest subsidy of 7% on term loans, capped at 1.2% of eligible fixed capital investment per annum for up to 10 years.
